targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "heart-rate" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT last("value") FROM "heart-rate" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/
SELECT last("value") FROM "resting-heart-rate" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/
SELECT mean("value") FROM "heart-rate-variability" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "blood-oxygen" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "respiratory-rate" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "walking-heart-rate" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT sum("value")
FROM "steps"
WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/
GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0)
SELECT sum("value") FROM "steps" WHERE "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ AND time >= now() - 1d
SELECT sum("value") FROM "flights-climbed" WHERE "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ AND time >= now() - 1d
SELECT sum("value") / 1000 FROM "distance-walking-running" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0)
SELECT sum("value") / 1000 FROM "distance-cycling" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0)
SELECT sum("value") / 60 FROM "exercise-time" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0)
SELECT sum("value") FROM "basal-energy-burned" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0)
SELECT sum("value") FROM "active-energy-burned" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0)
SELECT sum("value") FROM "active-energy-burned" WHERE "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ AND time >= now() - 1d
SELECT sum("value") FROM "basal-energy-burned" WHERE "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ AND time >= now() - 1d
SELECT sum("value") / 3600 FROM "sleep-deep" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0)
SELECT sum("value") / 3600 FROM "sleep-rem" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0)
SELECT sum("value") / 3600 FROM "sleep-asleep-core" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0)
SELECT sum("value") / 3600 FROM "sleep-awake" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0)
SELECT sum("value") / 3600 FROM "sleep-asleep" WHERE "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ AND time >= now() - 1d
SELECT sum("value") / 3600 FROM "sleep-in-bed" WHERE "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ AND time >= now() - 1d
SELECT "value" *0+4 AS "Awake" FROM "sleep-awake" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/
SELECT "value" *0+3 AS "REM Sleep" FROM "sleep-asleep-rem" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/
SELECT "value" *0+2  AS "Core Sleep" FROM "sleep-asleep-core" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/
SELECT "value" *0+1 AS "Deep Sleep" FROM "sleep-asleep-deep" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/
SELECT mean("value") FROM "weight" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null)
SELECT last("value") FROM "weight" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/
SELECT mean("value") FROM "body-mass-index" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "body-fat-percentage" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null)
SELECT * FROM "workout" WHERE $timeFilter AND "device-id" =~ /^$deviceId$/ ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 20
